concepts.description: A structural unit of the system that encapsulates components and types.
A physical or logical platform that embodies robotic capabilities within the system.
A defined set of values or events used for interaction between system components.
A component responsible for managing or coordinating system behavior.
A basic data type predefined by the system for representing simple values.
A structured data type composed of multiple fields of specified types.
A trigger or signal that can carry parameters and/or return values.
A callable unit of behavior that may take inputs and return outputs.

instances.description: The main module representing the AUV system.
The robotic platform component of the AUV system.
An interface providing sensor-related data such as depth, heading, and obstacle information.
An interface for actuator control, currently empty.
A controller handling operator-related inputs.
An interface defining input events such as task termination and mode requests.
A controller implementing the Last Response Engine functionality.
An interface defining output events such as velocity and heading adjustments.
A controller responsible for autopilot functions of the AUV.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing textual string values.
A primitive type representing true/false boolean values.
A primitive type representing real (floating-point) numbers.
A composite type representing a spherical vector with radial, polar, and azimuth components.
A composite type representing an obstacle with relative position, depth, ID, and heading.
An interface defining input events including task termination and various mode or value requests. Note: likely typo for 'Inputs'.
An event signaling the end of a task with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting OCM (possibly Operational Control Mode) with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting MOM (possibly Mission Operation Mode) with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting HCM (possibly Hover Control Mode) with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting current velocity, returning a value of type real.
An event requesting current heading, returning a value of type real.
An event to adjust velocity, taking one real parameter and returning no value.
An event to adjust heading, taking one real parameter and returning no value.
A composite type representing close proximity data with horizontal and vertical CDA and an ID.
A function that computes the Euclidean distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the horizontal distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the vertical distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
